s: Seder hatteqiot meyushshab ubo y"a seipim: tzarik litqoa meummad, shenneemar "yom terua yihyeh lakem", ulehallan hu omer "usepartem lakem", mah "lakem" haamur sham meummad kemo shennitbaer besiman tp"t ap kan meummad. Ulepikak lo yismok al shum dabar beinyan sheim yinnatel oto dabar shessamak alayv haya nopel, sheen zo amida ella semika. Umikkol maqom im abar vetaqa apillu meyushshab — yatza, veen tzarik lachazor velitqoa meummad, lepi sheamida zo enah ella middibre soperim kemo shennitbaer besiman ch' ubesiman tp"t ayyen sham:
Hashshomein hatteqiot ap al pi sheadayin lo yatzeu yede chobatan — ap al pi ken enan tzerikim laamod:
Nohagim litqoa al habbima bammaqom sheqqorin. Verauy litten litqoa letzaddiq vehagun, ubilbad shello yehe machaloqet baddabar:

Qodem sheyyitqa yebarek meummad "asher qiddeshanu bemitzvotayv vetzivvanu lishmoa qol shopar", velo yomar "beqol shopar" demashma letzayyet leqol hashshopar. Velamma en mebarekin "litqoa beshopar", lepi shehatteqia enah iqqar hammitzva ella shemiat qol shopar hu iqqar hammitzva, shehare hattoqea velo shama qol shopar lo yatza kemo she[yi]tebbaer besiman tqp"z ayyen sham. Umikkol maqom im abar o taa uberak "litqoa beshopar" o "al teqiat shopar" — yatza:

Veachar beraka zo yebarek shehecheyanu, lepi shehi mitzva habbaa[h] mizzeman lizman. Veechad hattoqea leatzmo veechad mi sheyyatza yede chobato vetoqea lehotzi acherim yede chobatan — mebarek shette berakot ellu. Bammeh debarim amurim? Kesheen hashshomea yodea lebarek, abal im hu yodea lebarek — yebarek beatzmo, velo yishma mimmi shekkebar yatza yede chobato kemo shennitbaer besiman ra"g, ayyen sham:

Veachar shebberak shette berakot ellu yitqa tshr"t g' peamim vetash"t g' peamim vetar"t g' peamim, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman tq"tz, ayyen sham. Mi shennistappeq lo im shama qol shopar beyom rishon shel rosh hashshana shehu min hattora — tzarik litqoa, abal lo yebarek shessepeq berakot lehaqel, veim hu beyom sheni sheeno ella middibre soperim — en tzarik litqoa, dispeq dibre soperim lehaqel. Toba litqoa betzad yamin shel piv im epshar lo bekak, mishshum shenneemar "vehassatan omed al yemino", vehatteqia mearbebet hassatan:
Vetob sheyyaamid peh hashshopar lemala velo yattennu litzdadim, shenneemar "ala elohim bitrua vego'":

Im hitchil litqoa velo yakol lehashlim kol hashsheloshim teqiot — yitqa acher tachtayv, veim gam hashsheni eno yakol lehashlim — yashlim acher tachtayv, veken leolam. Vekullam enam tzerikim lebarek, lepi shekkebar nipteru kullam bebirkat harishon. Vaapillu im harishon lo haya yakol litqoa apillu teqia achat — ap al pi ken lo hayeta birkato lebattala, kevan shekkavvanato hayeta bebirkato lehotzi kol hashshomein, veim ken hattoqein acharonim vekol haqqahal sheshshameu birkato enam tzerikim od lebarek. Abal im ba litqoa tachtayv mi shello shama birkato — tzarik lebarek qodem sheyyitqa, shehare hu lo yatza bebirkat harishon:

Bammeh debarim amurim? Keshettoqea zeh lo yatza adayin yede chobato shello shama adayin kol hatteqiot, abal im kebar yatza yede chobato sheshshama kebar kol hatteqiot bebet hakkeneset acheret — eno tzarik lebarek qodem sheyyitqa, shehare hatztzibbur shameu kebar habberaka min hattoqea harishon:
Nohagin shehammitpallel shacharit maqri seder hatteqiot lipne hattoqea milla bemilla kede shello yiteh bitqiotayv, uminhag yapeh hu. Veayyen besiman tq"tz:

(Asur littol sakar litqoa shopar berosh hashshana apillu sekaruhu meereb yom tob, lepi shehu notel sekar yom tob veasur mittaam shennitbaer besiman sh"v ayyen sham. Veim natal — eno roeh siman beraka meoto sakar leolam):
